notes: New: the Activity Log - every member's last-active time, days inactive, days-per-week on, and XP gained in the last 7 days, with an 'Online, not grinding' tag for members who show up but don't earn. Inactive day counts now keep growing past the game's week buckets, anchored on the last session actually seen. Click any column to sort, and filter by status. Set your own Danger Zone in Settings (1 day to 3 weeks), and the not-grinding bar too - both thresholds are yours. Members inactive past your Danger Zone appear in a red DANGER ZONE section of the Discord report, and reports now show when they were last scanned. The Activity Log can rebuild history from your past captures, so the new stats don't start empty.
